title: The Man Who Survived Both Atomic Bombs
notes: No free photograph of Tsutomu Yamaguchi exists on Wikimedia Commons. Portraits of him from 2009 are press images and are not freely licensed. This video therefore never shows his face. Do not generate one - see BUILD_SPEC section 3.
Commons holds graphic photographs of casualties at both cities. None are used here, and none should be added. The restraint is the editorial position, not squeamishness.
Every archival URL below was resolved from the Commons API and is a direct file URL.
v3: Yamaguchi appears only as an illustrated figure seen from behind, in silhouette or in shadow. His face is never shown, generated or otherwise.

v3: the bombs themselves are shown through the real cloud photographs (p06, p12) and as light, shadow and abstraction in the illustrations. No illustrated casualties, injuries or ruins with people in them.
v3: one recurring figure (Yamaguchi, dark suit, small travel bag) and one recurring object (the hanko). Generate a reference of each first and pass it with --ref.
